methodology: Warm in-memory databases; setup and worker startup excluded. SQL and data are identical across boundaries and hosts.
Latency includes query creation, complete typed row drain, fingerprint and cursor close. Comparisons occur after timing.
Every run checks row count, ordered typed fingerprint, column names/types, rowsAffected and final deterministic SQL cost.
The fingerprint is a pair of 32-bit accumulators, not a cryptographic proof; values are not retained after each row.
Direct/worker order alternates. Timers and browser observers run in separate responsiveness samples, never latency samples.
Timer gaps include the first delayed callback after work. Main-thread responsiveness does not measure worker cancellation latency.
7 latency samples per boundary are summarized by median and range; this report does not estimate tail percentiles.

cases.description: Generated exact-decimal sum; one result row
cases.sql: SELECT sum(g::decimal) AS total FROM generate_series(1, 1000000) g

cases.description: Complete drain of integer, decimal, bytes, array and NULL rows
cases.sql: SELECT g::i64 AS id, g::decimal AS exact, decode('0001feff', 'hex') AS bytes, ARRAY[g::i64, g::i64 + 1] AS pair, NULL::text AS absent FROM generate_series(1, 200000) g ORDER BY id
